routePolicy.name: omniscient_shortest_route
routePolicy.mapKnowledge: full generated floor grid is available before movement
routePolicy.stairsKnowledge: stairs coordinates are known before movement by the measurement oracle
routePolicy.bossKnowledge: mandatory milestone boss coordinates are known before movement by the measurement oracle
routePolicy.secretDoorKnowledge: generated secret doors are known and traversable from the start by the measurement oracle

productionKnowledge.stairs: coordinate is not known at run start; the player discovers stairs by entering the stairs cell; movement.js only provides a nearby wind omen within sensory range
productionKnowledge.boss: coordinate is not known at run start; movement.js provides a nearby boss/midboss aura within sensory range and starts the encounter on cell entry
productionKnowledge.secretDoor: a hidden door is not traversable while secretFound is false; an adjacent search action may reveal it, with arcaneSense providing a local hint but not global coordinates
productionKnowledge.extraWalking: not measured; the oracle route is a shortest-path lower bound and omits exploration detours, failed searches, and search-turn encounter exposure

modeled: production combat round resolution and auto-action
production 40% missing HP/MP camp recovery and CORE_CAMP_MASTER multiplier
measurement.survivorBias: oracle-route reached-depth distributions are conditional on each build reaching the target depth; they are not actual-run distributions. Started runs, reached depth, death depth, and encounters experienced are separately reported. Deep composition must not be interpreted as intrinsic encounter strength.

oracleRouteDominance.metric: highest reached depth per shared run

generatedFrequencyBestBuildShare.weighting: each generated encounter has equal weight within the requested depth sample; requested depths are equally sampled

buildConfidence.interpretation: oracle-route reached-depth distributions are survivor-conditioned and are not actual-run distributions

limits: generateEncounter output frequency is not observed full-run encounter frequency: traversal, event selection, bosses, midbosses, roaming elites, retreat, and run survival reweight encounters

strictReversalSummary.criterion: paired outcome and utility bootstrap 95% CIs exclude zero in both families, and both metrics reverse sign
